description: Start a coding task for a person on their own machine: POST /api/v1/tasks on OpenVibe.Codes, as a first-party service naming the person in X-OV-Subject (OpenVibe.Actor routes coding work here, plan T17). Codes submits it to OpenVibe.Run as that person, in the project of their latest openvibe.codes/run task, and Run places it only on a machine of theirs (platform.resource-offer@1 owner). The person pays nothing to OpenVibe for it: the model use is on their own machine's keys.
